parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation, organised targeting, or documented visitor-facing facility ban appears; the old public-order obscene-acts charge is not shown used against trans visitors, and repeal plus Pride, gay bars, and prison no-recorded-assaults give a tolerant climate signal. But traveller-specific protection is thin: border/document handling, hotel treatment, emergency-ward and detention placement are unresolved; there is no gender-identity anti-discrimination protection, partner recognition, or documented service-recourse, and media/regulatory hostility plus resident healthcare discrimination indicate friction and possible misgendering. Absence of violence data is not safety, but severity after outing looks mainly harassment/discrimination rather than imprisonment or severe state coercion. This sits in the lower reduced-risk band.
